title: Measuring Whether Safety Framework Adoption Correlates With Reduced AI Misuse Incidents

original_idea.body:
# Measuring Whether Safety Framework Adoption Correlates With Reduced AI Misuse Incidents

**Problem:** 12 AI labs published Frontier AI Safety Frameworks by end of 2025 (Bengio et al.). Whether framework adoption correlates with reduced misuse incidents is the foundational governance effectiveness question.

**Direction:** Construct a dataset of publicly documented AI misuse incidents from 2023-2026. For each lab involved, note whether they had a published safety framework at the time of the incident and when it was adopted. Use basic time-series and before-after analysis to test whether framework adoption correlates with incident rate changes.

**Why it matters:** This is the ultimate governance effectiveness question: do safety frameworks actually reduce harm? A preliminary correlation analysis would be the first empirical attempt to answer it.

**Relevant context:** Bengio et al. 2026 12 lab frameworks; GTG-1002, vibe hacking incident record; Anthropic misuse report Aug 2025.
